provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training: The primary caregiver training records were not available for review. A total of 10 hours were available for review from a previous Director credential course, dated February, 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training (26 TAC §747.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child's file did not have an immunization record available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Five children files did not include a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Pet Vaccinations: Three pets observed in the home did not have current vaccinations available for Licensing staff to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Pet Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.801(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The Parent Right information was not included in the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The indoor and outdoor physical activity information was not included with the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605: The primary caregivers adult son has been present at the home during daycare hours of operation without a background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605 (26 TAC §745.621(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained: The caregiver was not able to provide documentation of sign-in and sign-out logs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained (26 TAC §747.635(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One out of ten children records reviewed did not have an immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The diaper changing mat that is utilized for diaper changes has several tears.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §747.3303(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home: It was observed that the primary caregiver was supervising nine children ages 9 months, 11 months, two 18 months, one 19 months, one 2-year-old and 3 three-year-olds. The caregiver was over ratio by 2 children ages 18 months to three-years-old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: During the walk through, I observed a blanket in the play yard for two children ages 9 months and 11 months old while they were napping.     Note - this was corrected at inspection when the caregiver removed the blanket from the play yard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §747.2315(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There were no written feeding instructions available for the 9 month old and 11 month old infants that are not yet on table foods.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Four out of ten children records observed did not have current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: The children were allowed to watch television during naptime.    Note - This was corrected at inspection when the primary caregiver turned off the television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: The operation's liability insurance was not updated by the anniversary date and the documented date was expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §747.209(2))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The primary caregiver did not have 30 hours of required annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Crib Placement: During the walk through, I observed the play yards arranged where the infants had access to reach into each others play yard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Crib Placement (26 TAC §747.2303(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement: Two out of six children records observed did not include a health statement.   One child's health statement was dated 08/30/2021, which should have been updated by 08/2022.   One child's file did not contain a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on: The primary caregiver obtained a CPR/First-aid certification via web. There was no documentation for a hands-on course, and/or use of a manikin to properly rehearse/perform hands on skills based on instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: There was no statement of health for a pet ferret in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained: The children had not been signed in for the day.    Note- This was corrected during the inspection when the children were signed in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained (26 TAC §747.635(a))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The operation has not been testing the smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detectors monthly.    Note- This was corrected during the inspection when the primary caregiver tested the smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detectors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement: Two out of four children's records evaluated did not have a health statement signed by a physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation did not have a Children's Product Safety Annual Certification.    Note- This was corrected during the inspection when the primary caregiver completed a Children's Product Safety Annual Certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow: The operation does not have a written activitiy plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow (26 TAC §747.2102(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation has not conducted a fire drill in 2021.    Note- This was corrected during the inspection when the operation conducted a fire drill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: The children were allowed to watch television during naptime.    Note- This was corrected during the inspection when the television was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: Two out of three dogs did not have proof of up to date vaccinations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Complete Kit: The first aid kit was missing a thermometer, scissors, gauze, and medical tape.    Note- This was corrected during the inspection when the missing items were added to the first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Complete Kit (26 TAC §747.3803(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One out of four children's records evaluated did not have updated immunization records on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))
